_readme: India overrides. Only keys that differ from data.base.json belong here. See DATA-CONTRACT.md. India tuning = Indian English (British spelling), 'Resume' rather than 'CV', named-stack keyword density for keyword-driven recruiter and ATS screens, CGPA shown because the Indian convention expects it, and publications given prominence because IEEE/Springer carry real weight in this market. Notice period and current/expected CTC are deliberately NOT on the public site - they belong in the resume and the recruiter conversation, not on a public page. They are placeholders in the resume source instead.
_todo: TODO(in): set cv.href to assets/cv/in.pdf once the India resume PDF is exported from Country/in/resume_in.html. Until the file is on disk the build omits the resume button from this page - that is the intended fail-safe, not a bug.

TODO(in): decide with Prajwall whether CGPA  should stay visible. flags.showGrade is true here because the Indian convention expects a CGPA and omitting it reads as concealment, but some product companies screen on it. Setting it to false is a one-line change.
headline: AI Engineer — agentic and LLM systems, and the platform they run on
summary: AI Engineer on the founding team at **Colligence Research**, Bengaluru. I work across both halves of the stack: I build the product — multi-agent and LLM pipelines over **MCP**, a code-generation service, **Python** and **FastAPI** backends — and I own the platform it runs on, having set up **CI/CD**, infrastructure-as-code with **OpenTofu** and **Ansible**, **Docker**, **Zitadel** authentication, observability and incident response from scratch. **IEEE- and Springer-published**, with three peer-reviewed papers and two more under review.
